categories.data: the record of each sync of the owner's collection: when it ran, what started it, its outcome and reason code, how many attempts it took, and whether it downloaded the whole collection
categories.purpose: running the daily sync, showing the owner its outcome, and paging when it stops

categories.data: what the last recompute of the owner's reviews saw (the newest review's id, the card count and its fingerprint, the study day, when it ran and the settings generation it read), whether the owner asked for a rescore, the reason and the time a request of the owner was refused, and the base of the review window
categories.purpose: recomputing the owner's scores only when their collection or their settings changed

categories.data: the settings generation: one counter of how many times the owner's settings changed, and a digest of the owner's courses file, which says whether the file changed
categories.purpose: telling the recompute that a setting or the courses changed

categories.data: every XP grant: the study day it pays for, an opaque token of what it was for, the track, the amount, whether it pays once a study day or once ever, and when it was written
categories.purpose: keeping the owner's XP total and level, and paying each award at most once

categories.data: the record of each resolution of the owner's readings for a study day: what started it, the study day, when it ran, its outcome with its class and reason when it was refused as a whole, and how many decks with new cards mapped to no topic
categories.purpose: resolving the owner's daily readings, and showing the owner why a study day has none

categories.data: each reading topic's state for each study day, with its class and reason, and for a topic with new cards the ids of those cards and of their notes, their count and their digest
categories.purpose: giving each reading topic one honest state each study day, and the new cards its reading primes

categories.data: the record of each AI duty run: the duty, the persona template, the subject, how the run ended with its cause or its class, the turns, the tokens and the cost the run reported, and how long it took; never the prompt and never the reply
categories.purpose: showing the owner why a duty delivered nothing, and keeping each run's cost visible

categories.data: each study day's rollup of the owner's reviews: the counts by kind of answer, the seconds answering, the true retention and its young and mature split, the graduations and the decks studied; the card state recorded for the day with when it was recorded; the five-pillar score, the score the day closed with and when it was settled; and a fingerprint of the day's reviews
categories.purpose: scoring each study day once it closes, and showing the owner each day's numbers and score

categories.data: each course's reviews, seconds answering, first answers and passes on each study day, by the course's code
categories.purpose: showing the owner how each study day's work was split across their courses

categories.data: every decision the notification router made about an occasion: its opaque key, its kind, the surface, whether it was sent, deferred or withheld and why, the tier asked for and the tier rendered, and the study day
categories.purpose: keeping one record of why each celebration or nudge was sent, held or withheld

categories.data: each delivered occasion's opaque key with its kind, the scope it holds that key in, the surface, the study day and the lapse it belongs to
categories.purpose: delivering each celebration or nudge at most once across the bot and the Mini App, and capping comebacks per lapse

categories.data: the celebrations held by quiet hours or a failed send: their text, key, kind and tiers, why and since when they are held, and how often a send failed
categories.purpose: delivering a held celebration once quiet hours end or sends succeed, and naming every one that is abandoned

categories.data: the celebrations delivered to the Mini App: their text, key, kind and tier, and when the Mini App fetched them
categories.purpose: showing the owner in the Mini App the celebrations raised there

categories.data: the owner's notification settings: which kinds are switched off, and the owner's quiet hours
categories.purpose: honouring the owner's choices about which notifications to receive and when to stay quiet

categories.data: the id of the owner's latest message to the bot and when it arrived
categories.purpose: reacting to the owner's latest message when a small celebration lands

categories.data: the latest report of each research instrument that reads the owner's collection: the study day it was built for, its shape version, its findings about the owner's own cards and note types, and the name of each read that failed
categories.purpose: showing the owner what each instrument last found, and running each weekly instrument once in seven study days
